offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures residential and commercial heating, air conditioning, heat pump and refrigeration equipment. Sells mainly through distributors, dealers and direct to commercial customers, and also supplies parts.

primary_products.value: residential furnaces; air conditioners and heat pumps; commercial rooftop units; refrigeration systems; indoor air quality products and parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC dealers and contractors, distributors, commercial building owners, national accounts, homebuilders; B2C: Homeowners buying replacement equipment via dealers and company-owned stores

end_markets.value: residential housing; commercial buildings; retail and food service; refrigeration and cold chain

revenue_model.value: product sales: HVAC and refrigeration equipment, parts and supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds HVAC and refrigeration equipment from purchased components, sold to dealers, distributors and commercial customers; brand owner: markets branded equipment lines to contractors and building owners

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada primarily, with some international sales

specialization.value: related lines: residential HVAC, commercial HVAC and refrigeration equipment sharing channels and technology

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealers and distributors serving contractors and homeowners; own locations: company-owned parts and supplies stores; direct sales: national accounts and commercial customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: energy efficiency standards (DOE), refrigerant rules (EPA), and safety and environmental regulations
